title: Workbench replies while Sources continues
description: The analyst converses with Workbench during documentary preparation. Stop response belongs only to that answer.
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Render a crisp, legible 1440x1000 desktop Workbench screen, edge to edge. Preserve the supplied screenshot’s Geist typography, charcoal surfaces, violet accents, 60/40 split (Progress left, chat right), "// Workbench Agent" header, closed context, and bottom Raised neutral composer. No new navigation, sidebar, decorative cards, provider logos, or device frame. Disclose "Illustrative · no research executed". Retain one chat in order: user "Does CCC control the claims workflow, or supply modules an agent could replace?"; assistant "I can help frame this research before it starts."; acknowledgement "Research started. Sources is preparing the documentary material." Assistant prose stays unboxed without repeated author labels; mission activity is explicitly attributed to Sources. Copy actions are icon-only. STATE: TWO INDEPENDENT EXECUTIONS IN THE SAME CHAT. Progress remains collecting, with 14 found, 2 capturing, 6 captured. After the retained acknowledgement, show the same open unboxed Sources mission: "Sources · Documentary preparation", running indicator, "Working · 24s". Show a completed "Check supplied reference" row and a running "Find company reporting" row. Then below that mission activity, the analyst bubble asks "Does this already establish that CCC controls the workflow?" Below it Workbench streams ordinary unboxed prose: "No conclusion is established yet. Sources is still collecting material. I’ll distinguish who sets the rules from who executes them…" with a subtle text caret. A quiet "Stop response" control sits directly below this partial answer, clearly part of that answer. Sources still visibly says Working. Keep the compact composer below everything, placeholder "Ask about the sources…". No research pause or cancellation control is invented.
